instruction: Use the exact spent V2 robustness failure to synthesize a new context-dependent representation policy. The policy may see only predictions/agreement from YADO's existing V3/V4 views plus generic wrapper/length signals. Give identical spent evidence to multiple existing native learner families and let native precommit selection choose the family. Do not provide domain words, a target rule, a selected family, a selected capability label rule, or fresh V3 cases before selection.
pass_only_if: a native learner family is selected under precommit
